content:
nora_eng: quick postmortem follow-up 1: recurring pattern = feature-flag promote exceeded intended replica cap because controller trusted client config. need server-side guards.
sam_backend: noted. minimal plan: server-side validation + hard caps + 'who_approved' audit + shadow mode. keep defaults conservative.
jon_sre: add regional quorum logic and a fast circuit-breaker when replica count spikes + error climb. also require controller-aggregated metrics as truth.
maria_p: I'll prepare synthetic replays and metric skews for the shadow runs. want 2-week shadow to measure FP/FN.
tanya_pm: exec asks: one-pager + owners by EOD Fri. keep incremental PRs so we can ship early.
sam_backend: incremental PR plan: PR1 config validation + audit field (3d), PR2 hard-cap enforcement + descriptive error (5d), PR3 regional-quorum + breaker (2w), PR4 shadow telemetry + dashboards (2w).
nora_eng: owners: sam_backend PR1/2, li_dev+jon_sre PR3, jon_sre runbook, maria_p evals. we'll run shadow in shadow-mode before enforcement.
deploy-bot: queued shadow run #shadow-333 for service=frontend at 2026-04-06T08:00Z (results to #eng-platform).
ops-bot: FYI: we'll page SRE for any auto-promote beyond 20% during the experiment.
nora_eng: thanks all. I'll draft the exec summary and action tracker and post here. respond with blockers.
